QUOTE: When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ... ref={ref} />`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch, rendered only when `hasSearch` is true. It never says the ref is attached to nothing when `hasSearch` is false, but that follows from the conditional render, and its table shows the other callers leave `hasSearch` unset.
